outlook.statement: The proposed change of name is being undertaken in consonance with the new strategy and the business plan to carry on the business more advantageously under the new brand name of RCCL.

India's economic growth remained robust during the year, supported by strong domestic demand, resilient private consumption and sustained public investment. The outlook remains resilient, with consumption, investment, infrastructure spending and structural reforms expected to support medium-term growth, although geopolitical tensions, trade uncertainties and energy price volatility remain key risks.

ROML remains focused on building sustainable growth by strengthening its presence in the edible oil and food essentials market. The Company expects continued opportunities from evolving consumer preferences, increasing demand for branded products, rural and urban consumption growth, and the expanding adoption of organised retail, E-Commerce and Quick Commerce. Going forward, ROML will continue to focus on expanding market reach, strengthening its distribution network, improving manufacturing and supply chain efficiencies, and enhancing brand and consumer engagement. The Company will also leverage digital platforms and data-driven insights to respond more effectively to changing consumption patterns and emerging market opportunities. The Company remains committed to prudent cost management, operational efficiency and disciplined execution while navigating factors such as commodity price volatility, competitive intensity, inflationary pressures and changing market conditions.
